design_revision: Use the local MiniMax M3 coding plan specified by the user: replace the unexecuted 2-model x 4-block draft with 1 model x 8 paired blocks, still 16 runs. No cross-model inference. Blocks 3-6 copied byte-for-byte from the old draft; blocks 7-10 use the same generator.

provider_immutable_versions.MiniMax-M3: unknown; catalog alias, not a claimed immutable snapshot

primary_contrast: 100 * (validation-selected test gap of relational_branch minus niche_fixed_dev), percentage points; negative favors relational_branch
repeated_unit: Eight independently generated data blocks, paired across two controllers within MiniMax-M3. Instances and individual calls are not search replications.
threshold_rationale: Engineering screening decisions, not established universal standards: a 0.2 percentage-point absolute reduction is about 3.3% of a 6% gap; tolerate up to 25% mean billed-token increase under the same proposal count.

mechanism_observability.interpretation: diagnostic only, never an inclusion filter or a superiority threshold; additionally report differentiated family scores, full-vs-gain and full-vs-FIFO differences

failure_policy: No replacement proposals or automatic POST retries. Indeterminate requests stop their run. Missing usage stays null. Preserve every planned job; stop dispatch after two consecutive infrastructure-incomplete jobs and mark the rest not-started. Completed-pair estimates exclude incomplete pairs only with explicit missingness counts and no superiority claim.
test_access_policy: No test evaluation until all planned searches are terminal or an infrastructure halt is recorded. Test evaluation runs separately after the validation output is frozen. Test execution failure penalty: 1.0 gap, with validity reported.
selection_quality_policy: Competitive at admission; do not re-gate existing B entries. Capacity 3, 2 continuation opportunities, odd proposal slots, fixed 24 2-opt checks; shared niche ordinary scheduler; W disabled.
scoring_policy: Unchanged: q(tag) + 0.25 * parent_gain/(1+attempts). Report term scales without tuning the formula on this batch.
preflight_policy: One separately archived non-task engineering request, at most 512 output tokens. Not included as a search replicate or in search-only costs.
claims: Exploratory same-proposal-budget screening on TSP14 with MiniMax-M3; no cross-model, causal family-only, portfolio-utility or confirmed-superiority claims. No automatic expansion beyond this 16-job matrix.
